title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Sequential and Ecological Program for Sustainable Resilience of the Sila Populations programme will work in Sila Province, Chad. It aims to contribute to Concern Chad's Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure extremely poor and vulnerable households are more productive, can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. The programme will support over 110,970 people living in extreme poor households, subsistence farmers, pastoralists, female-headed households, households with disabled members. This will be done through ensuring access to a predictable and regular source of income to cover basic needs, increased access to basic services, improved knowledge of labour market opportunities, increased employment among participant households including in jobs focused on prevention or restoring the environment.. Capacity Building 2: The main focus of this outcome is to strengthen the capacity of partners.
